definitions.gloss: love at first sight; falling in love at first glance
definitions.explanation: The experience of immediately falling in love with someone (or occasionally something) upon seeing them for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一目惚|ひとめぼ}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I fell in love with her at first sight.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一目惚|ひとめぼ}れだった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think it was love at first sight.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一目惚|ひとめぼ}れ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、つい⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまった。
examples.english: I fell in love with this bag at first sight and ended up buying it.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {一目惚|ひとめぼ}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Can be used for people (romantic) or things (an item you instantly want). The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the object of attraction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一目惚|ひとめぼ}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fall in love at first sight)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一目惚|ひとめぼ}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (fell in love with ~ at first sight)
- {一目惚|ひとめぼ}れだった (it was love at first sight)

FORMS:
⟦{一目|ひとめ}→一目：08728_hitome⟧ (one glance) + {惚|ほ}れ (falling in love). ⟦{惚|ほ}れる→惚れる：12600_horeru⟧ is a verb meaning "to fall in love."
